id: tummy-reach

why.id: Bayi belajar gerak dr usaha, bukan dr dibantu. Jarak sedikit itu ruang buat dia mencoba.
why.en: Babies learn movement from effort, not from being handed things. That small gap is where the trying happens.

id: Baringkan bayi di alas yg rata dan agak keras.
Taruh satu benda menarik sejauh satu telapak tangan dr ujung jarinya.
Diam dan tunggu, walaupun lama. Jangan didekatkan.
en: Lay your baby on a firm, flat surface.
Put one interesting object a hand's width past their fingers.
Say nothing and wait, even when it takes a while. Don't slide it closer.

materials.id: Satu benda bertekstur atau berbunyi lembut.
materials.en: One object with texture or a soft sound.

safety.id: Alas rata, jangan di kasur atau tepi sofa. Bendanya harus lebih besar dr lubang tisu gulung.
safety.en: Firm surface, never a bed or a sofa edge. The object must be too big to pass through a toilet-paper tube.

imageAlt.id: Mainan kayu lembut di atas alas main, sedikit di luar jangkauan.
imageAlt.en: A soft wooden rattle on a play mat, just beyond reach.

id: texture-tour

why.id: Menamai apa yg lagi disentuh bayi membangun bahasa jauh sebelum dia bisa bicara.
why.en: Naming what a baby is touching builds language long before they can talk.

id: Pilih lima permukaan aman: tirai, kaca jendela yg sejuk, sendok kayu, daun, handuk.
Biarkan tangannya menyentuh duluan, baru kamu sebut namanya.
Tunggu suara atau tatapannya sebelum pindah ke berikutnya.
en: Pick five safe textures: a curtain, a cool window, a wooden spoon, a leaf, a towel.
Let their hand land first, then name it.
Wait for their sound or look before moving on.

materials.id: Rumahmu sendiri.
materials.en: Your own house.

safety.id: Lewati apa pun yg panas, tajam, berlistrik, atau cukup kecil utk masuk lubang tisu gulung.
safety.en: Skip anything hot, sharp, electrical, or small enough to fit through a toilet-paper tube.

imageAlt.id: Lima tekstur rumah tangga berjajar: tirai, kaca, sendok kayu, daun, handuk.
imageAlt.en: Five household textures in a row: curtain, glass, wooden spoon, leaf, towel.

id: treasure-basket

why.id: Benda asli lebih kaya dr mainan plastik, dan memilih sendiri itu bagian yg bikin dia betah lama.
why.en: Real objects are richer than plastic toys, and choosing for himself is what makes the concentration last.

id: Isi keranjang dangkal dgn 5–6 benda asli dr bahan berbeda: kayu, logam, kain, alam.
Duduk di sampingnya dan biarkan dia yg memimpin sepenuhnya.
Tahan diri utk menyodorkan, mencontohkan, atau menamai — kecuali dia menoleh ke kamu.
en: Fill a shallow basket with 5–6 real objects of different materials: wood, metal, fabric, natural.
Sit beside them and let them lead entirely.
Resist handing, demonstrating or naming unless they look up at you.

materials.id: Sendok kayu, pengocok telur, potongan kain, sikat kecil, gelas silikon.
materials.en: A wooden spoon, a whisk, a fabric scrap, a small brush, a silicone cup.

safety.id: Semua benda harus lebih besar dr lubang tisu gulung, gak gampang pecah, gak ada lapisan yg mengelupas, dan gak ada tali atau gagang panjang.
safety.en: Every object must be too big for a toilet-paper tube, unbreakable, with no coating that can flake and no cord or long handle.

imageAlt.id: Keranjang anyaman dangkal berisi benda rumah tangga asli di atas karpet.
imageAlt.en: A shallow woven basket of real household objects on a rug.

id: peekaboo-scarf

why.id: Permainan bergantian paling tua yg ada, dan dia yg menentukan ritmenya.
why.en: The oldest turn-taking game there is, played at your baby's pace instead of yours.

id: Tutup wajahmu sendiri dgn selendang tipis, bukan wajahnya.
Tunggu suara atau gerak tangannya dulu, baru buka.
Berhenti begitu dia mengalihkan pandangan — itu caranya bilang sudah cukup.
en: Drape a light scarf over your own face, not theirs.
Wait for their sound or reach before you reveal.
Stop the moment they look away — that's them saying done.

materials.id: Satu selendang tipis yg mudah ditembus udara.
materials.en: One light, breathable scarf.

safety.id: Selendangnya di wajahmu, bukan di wajah bayi. Jangan pernah tinggalkan kain di dekat wajahnya.
safety.en: The scarf goes over you, never the baby. Never leave fabric on or near a baby's face.

imageAlt.id: Selendang tipis melayang setengah terangkat di atas bantal.
imageAlt.en: A light scarf caught mid-air, half-lifted above a cushion.

id: post-the-lids

why.id: Pengulangan itu bukan kebosanan buat dia — itu cara dia memastikan dunianya bisa ditebak.
why.en: Repetition isn't boredom to a toddler — it's how they confirm the world is predictable.

id: Lubangi tutup kardus sebesar telapak tangan, atau pakai toples bermulut lebar.
Contohkan sekali, pelan, lalu serahkan.
Biarkan dia mengulang jauh setelah kamu sendiri bosan.
en: Cut one hand-sized hole in a box lid, or use a wide-mouth jar.
Show it once, slowly, then hand it over.
Let them repeat it far past the point where you're bored.

materials.id: Kardus atau toples lebar, plus benda besar: tutup toples, balok, ring kayu.
materials.en: A box or wide jar, plus large objects: jar lids, blocks, wooden rings.

safety.id: Semua benda lebih besar dr lubang tisu gulung, dan tepi lubangnya gak tajam.
safety.en: Every object larger than a toilet-paper tube, and no cut edges on the hole.

imageAlt.id: Kardus berlubang bundar dgn tutup toples berserakan di sampingnya.
imageAlt.en: A box with a round hole in its lid, jar lids scattered beside it.

id: sponge-transfer

title.en: Move the water with a sponge

why.id: Airnya yg mengoreksi, bukan kamu. Tumpah itu bagian dr kegiatannya, bukan kegagalannya.
why.en: The water does the correcting, not you. The spill is part of the activity, not a failure of it.

id: Taruh dua mangkuk dangkal di atas handuk, satu diisi sedikit air.
Contohkan cara memerasnya sekali.
Taruh lap kecil di sebelahnya, dan biarkan dia sendiri yg mengelap.
en: Set two shallow bowls on a towel, one with a little water.
Show the squeeze once.
Put a small cloth beside them and let them mop it themselves.

materials.id: Dua mangkuk dangkal, satu spons kecil, handuk, lap.
materials.en: Two shallow bowls, one small sponge, a towel, a cloth.

safety.id: Airnya sedikit saja dan selalu dalam jangkauan tanganmu. Balita bisa tenggelam di air beberapa sentimeter.
safety.en: A very small amount of water, always within arm's reach. A toddler can drown in a few centimetres.

imageAlt.id: Dua mangkuk dangkal di atas handuk dgn spons menetes di antaranya.
imageAlt.en: Two shallow bowls on a towel with a sponge dripping between them.

id: tape-line

why.id: Satu garis bisa jd titian, jalan raya, atau gak jd apa-apa. Yg dia bikin dr garis itu justru kegiatannya.
why.en: One line becomes a balance beam, a road, or nothing at all. Whatever they turn it into is the activity.

id: Tempel lakban lurus atau melengkung di lantai.
Jalani sekali sendiri, lalu berhenti mengarahkan.
Ikuti aturan main yg dia bikin, walau berubah tiap menit.
en: Run a straight or curved line of tape along the floor.
Walk it once yourself, then stop directing.
Follow whatever rules they invent, even if they change every minute.

materials.id: Lakban kertas atau washi tape.
materials.en: Masking or washi tape.

safety.id: Bersihkan lintasannya dr sudut furnitur yg keras. Kaki telanjang atau kaus kaki anti-selip.
safety.en: Clear the run of hard furniture corners. Bare feet or grippy socks.

imageAlt.id: Garis lakban melengkung di lantai kayu dgn sepasang kaus kaki kecil di pangkalnya.
imageAlt.en: A masking-tape line curving across a wooden floor with small socks at its start.

id: laundry-hand-off

why.id: Kerja beneran, dikerjakan bareng, tanpa standar yg harus dicapai. Balita ingin ikut, bukan ditemani main.
why.en: Real work, done together, with no standard to meet. Toddlers want to take part, not to be entertained.

id: Duduk di dekat keranjang dan sodorkan satu helai satu-satu.
Biarkan dia yg memasukkan ke mesin atau ke tumpukan.
Terima kasihnya utk kerjanya, bukan utk hasilnya yg rapi.
en: Sit by the basket and hand them one item at a time.
Let them put it in the machine or the pile.
Thank them for the work, not for doing it neatly.

materials.id: Cucian yg memang sudah ada.
materials.en: The laundry you already have.

safety.id: Pintu mesin tertutup dan mati kalau ditinggal. Deterjen kapsul disingkirkan sepenuhnya dr ruangan.
safety.en: Machine door closed and off when unattended. Keep detergent capsules completely out of the room.

imageAlt.id: Keranjang cucian setengah terisi dgn satu kaus kaki kecil di lantai.
imageAlt.en: A laundry basket half-loaded with one small sock on the floor beside it.

id: pouring-jug

why.id: Presentasi Montessori klasik: tunjukkan sekali, lalu serahkan kendalinya sepenuhnya.
why.en: The classic Montessori presentation: show once, then hand over control completely.

id: Isi teko kecil setengah, taruh dua gelas di atas nampan.
Tuang sekali, pelan, tanpa menjelaskan sambil jalan.
Taruh lapnya dalam jangkauannya dan jangan komentari tumpahannya.
en: Half-fill a small jug and set two cups on a tray.
Pour once, slowly, without narrating.
Put the cloth where they can reach it and say nothing about spills.

materials.id: Teko kecil yg muat satu tangan, dua gelas, nampan, lap.
materials.en: A small jug they can hold one-handed, two cups, a tray, a cloth.

safety.id: Air suhu ruang saja. Keramik boleh, asal kamu siap kalau pecah.
safety.en: Room-temperature water only. Ceramic is fine if you're comfortable with it breaking.

imageAlt.id: Teko kecil menuang ke dua gelas di atas nampan kayu.
imageAlt.en: A small jug mid-pour over two cups on a wooden tray.

id: wash-one-cup

why.id: Satu tugas utuh dgn awal dan akhir yg kelihatan. Anak usia ini lebih bangga sm tugas selesai daripada sm pujian.
why.en: One whole task with a visible beginning and end. At this age, a finished job means more than praise.

id: Siapkan stasiun rendah: baskom, spons, handuk.
Contohkan urutannya sekali.
Tinggalkan dia mengerjakannya, termasuk bagian yg hasilnya berantakan.
en: Set a low station: bowl, sponge, towel.
Demonstrate the sequence once.
Leave them to it, including the parts they do badly.

materials.id: Baskom air hangat, spons kecil, satu gelas gak gampang pecah, handuk.
materials.en: A bowl of warm water, a small sponge, one unbreakable cup, a towel.

safety.id: Hangat, bukan panas. Sabun yg gak perih di mata. Bangkunya harus stabil.
safety.en: Warm not hot. Soap that doesn't sting eyes. The stool must be stable.

imageAlt.id: Stasiun cuci rendah: baskom, spons, satu gelas, handuk terlipat.
imageAlt.en: A low washing station: a bowl, a sponge, one cup and a folded towel.

id: sort-your-way

why.id: Kamu yg menyiapkan bendanya, dia yg bikin aturannya. Aturan versinya itu justru intinya.
why.en: You supply the objects; they supply the rule. Their rule is the point.

id: Tumpahkan 10–15 benda rumah tangga campur dan dua mangkuk kosong.
Bilang "boleh dipisahin sesukamu", lalu diam.
Kalau dia memisahkan pakai aturan yg gak kepikiran olehmu, berarti berhasil.
en: Tip out 10–15 mixed household objects and two empty bowls.
Say "you can sort these however you like", then stay quiet.
If they sort by something you'd never have chosen, that's the successful version.

materials.id: Kancing besar, tutup botol, sendok, balok, kaus kaki.
materials.en: Large buttons, bottle caps, spoons, blocks, socks.

safety.id: Jangan pakai benda yg muat di lubang tisu gulung kalau ada adik yg lebih kecil di ruangan yg sama.
safety.en: Nothing that fits through a toilet-paper tube if a younger sibling is in the room.

imageAlt.id: Kancing, tutup botol, dan sendok tersebar di lantai di antara dua mangkuk kosong.
imageAlt.en: Buttons, bottle caps and spoons spread on a floor between two empty bowls.

id: calm-basket-together

why.id: Menyiapkan kotaknya saat semua lagi tenang jauh lebih berguna daripada mencarinya di tengah tantrum.
why.en: Assembling the box while nobody is upset works far better than looking for it mid-meltdown.

id: Sodorkan keranjang, lalu tanya apa yg bikin dia enakan waktu perasaannya lagi besar.
Masukkan apa pun yg dia sebut, walau menurutmu gak ada gunanya.
Sebutkan perasaan yg muncul saat ngobrol, tanpa buru-buru membereskannya.
en: Offer a basket and ask what helps when their feelings get big.
Put in whatever they say, even if it seems useless to you.
Name the feelings that come up as you talk, without fixing them.

materials.id: Keranjang, plus pilihannya: boneka, gambar, bola remas, selimut.
materials.en: A basket, plus their choices: a soft toy, a picture, a squeeze ball, a blanket.

safety.id: Jangan masukkan apa pun yg bisa diikat, dililitkan, atau ditarik ke kepala.
safety.en: Nothing that can be tied, wrapped, or pulled over the head.

imageAlt.id: Keranjang berisi boneka lembut, gambar anak, bola remas, dan selimut terlipat.
imageAlt.en: A basket holding a soft toy, a child's drawing, a squeeze ball and a folded blanket.

id: special-play-time

why.id: Ini sesi mingguan yg dipakai di filial therapy, dijalankan sm orang tua di rumah. Kalau cuma satu kegiatan yg kamu coba dr buklet ini, ambil yg ini.
why.en: This is the weekly session used in filial therapy, run by the parent at home. If you try only one activity in this booklet, make it this one.

id: 20 menit, satu anak, waktu dan tempat yg tetap, ponsel di ruangan lain.
Dia yg menentukan semuanya. Kamu ikut, dan ikut bermain hanya kalau diajak — gak mengajari, gak bertanya, gak menyarankan.
Ceritakan apa yg kamu lihat ("Kamu lagi kasih susu bayinya"), pantulkan perasaannya ("Kaget ya tadi"), dan puji usahanya, bukan hasilnya ("Kamu coba terus sampai bisa").
Kasih aba-aba lima menit dan satu menit sebelum selesai.
en: 20 minutes, one child, a consistent time and place, phone in another room.
They choose everything. You follow, and join in only when invited — no teaching, no questions, no suggestions.
Describe what you see ("You're giving the baby a bottle"), reflect what they feel ("That surprised you"), and praise the effort, never the result ("You kept trying until you got it").
Give a five-minute and a one-minute warning before you stop.

materials.id: Barang sederhana yg gak pakai baterai: kertas dan krayon, boneka, binatang-binatangan, balok, mobil-mobilan.
materials.en: Simple non-mechanical things: paper and crayons, a doll, animals, blocks, cars.

imageAlt.id: Sudut ruangan sederhana dgn kertas, krayon, boneka, balok, dan mobil-mobilan.
imageAlt.en: A simple room corner set with paper, crayons, a doll, blocks and cars.

id: draw-and-reflect

title.en: Draw anything, I'll just be here

why.id: Pertanyaan "ini gambar apa?" membuat anak menebak jawaban yg kamu mau. Menceritakan apa yg kamu lihat gak menuntut apa-apa.
why.en: "What is it?" makes a child guess the answer you want. Describing what you see asks nothing of them.

id: Kertas dan krayon, kalian berdua di meja.
Sebutkan warna, gerakan, pilihannya — "biru kamu banyak di situ ya".
Jangan tanya "ini apa?", dan jangan betulkan warna atau bentuknya.
en: Paper and crayons, both of you at the table.
Describe colours, movements, choices — "you used a lot of blue there".
Never ask "what is it?", and never correct a colour or a shape.

materials.id: Kertas dan krayon.
materials.en: Paper and crayons.

imageAlt.id: Gambar anak yg sedang dikerjakan dgn krayon berserakan di sekelilingnya.
imageAlt.en: A child's drawing in progress with crayons scattered around it.

id: pretend-kitchen

why.id: Buat orang tua yg menyayangi lewat tindakan: di sini yg bertindak dia, dan kamu yg dilayani.
why.en: For parents who show love by doing: here the doing is theirs, and you're the one being served.

id: Dia yg masak, kamu yg pesan dan makan.
Terima apa pun yg datang, termasuk bagian yg jelas gak bisa dimakan.
Selipkan satu kata perasaan di tengahnya: "kayaknya kamu bangga sm yg ini".
en: They cook, you order and eat.
Accept whatever arrives, including the inedible parts of the game.
Slip in one feeling word somewhere: "you look proud of that one".

materials.id: Panci, sendok, gelas — apa pun yg sudah ada di kotak mainan.
materials.en: Pots, spoons, cups — whatever is already in the toy box.

safety.id: Gak pakai apa pun dr kompor beneran.

imageAlt.id: Panci dan cangkir mainan ditata seperti meja restoran kecil.
imageAlt.en: Toy pots and cups arranged as a tiny restaurant table.

id: wash-the-toys

why.id: Kerja nyata dgn air nyata — persis cara orang tua tipe Doer menunjukkan sayang, dan anak usia ini bisa lama sekali di situ.
why.en: Real work with real water — exactly how Doer parents love, and children this age will stay with it for a long time.

id: Baskom air hangat, sikat lembut, handuk.
Dia mencuci, kamu mencuci di sebelahnya tanpa mengawasi hasilnya.
Kalau dia bilang satu mainan sudah bersih, berarti sudah bersih.
en: A basin of warm water, a soft brush, a towel.
They wash, you wash beside them without supervising the quality.
When they say a toy is clean, it's clean.

materials.id: Baskom, air hangat, sikat lembut, handuk, mainan yg boleh kena air.
materials.en: A basin, warm water, a soft brush, a towel, washable toys.

safety.id: Air dangkal, jangan ditinggal. Jangan mainan elektronik.
safety.en: Shallow water, never unattended. No electronic toys.

imageAlt.id: Baskom air bersabun dgn mainan dan sikat lembut, handuk terbentang.
imageAlt.en: A basin of soapy water with toys and a soft brush, a towel spread beside.

id: treasure-map

title.en: A treasure map of our house

why.id: Menggambar peta lalu mengikutinya itu berpikir simbolik yg langsung dipakai — dan seru.
why.en: Drawing a map and then following it is symbolic thinking with legs.

id: Dia menggambar peta satu ruangan, seakurat apa pun hasilnya.
Sembunyikan satu benda kecil bareng, lalu tandai di petanya.
Ikuti petanya, bukan pengetahuanmu soal rumah sendiri.
en: They draw a map of a room, however inaccurate.
Hide something small together and mark it.
Follow their map, not your knowledge of the house.

materials.id: Kertas, krayon, satu benda kecil utk disembunyikan.
materials.en: Paper, crayons, one small object to hide.

safety.id: Sepakati dulu ruangan mana yg boleh dipakai.
safety.en: Agree which rooms are in play.

imageAlt.id: Peta rumah gambar krayon dgn tanda X dan satu benda kecil di sebelahnya.
imageAlt.en: A crayon map of a house marked with an X, a small object beside it.

id: obstacle-course

why.id: Dia yg merancang, kamu yg mencoba. Menjadi pembuat aturan itu latihan yg jarang dia dapat.
why.en: They design it, you attempt it. Being the rule-maker is practice they rarely get.

id: Dia yg menyusun lintasannya dan menentukan aturannya.
Kamu jalan duluan, dan ikuti aturannya persis.
Biarkan aturannya berubah di tengah jalan, karena pasti berubah.
en: They design the course and set the rules.
You go first, and follow their rules exactly.
Let them change the rules mid-course, because they will.

materials.id: Bantal, lakban, kursi, selimut.
materials.en: Cushions, tape, chairs, a blanket.

safety.id: Gak ada yg dipanjat lebih tinggi dr pinggangnya sendiri. Jauhkan sudut furnitur yg keras.
safety.en: Nothing to climb higher than their own hip. Clear the corners of hard furniture.

imageAlt.id: Bantal, kursi, lakban, dan selimut ditata jd lintasan di lantai ruang keluarga.
imageAlt.en: Cushions, a chair, tape and a blanket arranged as a route across a living-room floor.

id: turn-story

why.id: Cerita yg dibangun berdua, pelan, sebelum tidur. Menerima gilirannya apa adanya itu bentuk lain dr mendengarkan.
why.en: A story built by two people, slowly, before bed. Accepting their turn as it comes is another form of listening.

id: Kamu mulai dgn satu kalimat, dia menyambung satu kalimat.
Terima setiap giliran yg dia ambil, termasuk yg merusak alur versimu.
Kalau dia menutup ceritanya, berarti ceritanya sudah selesai.
en: You start with one sentence, they add the next.
Accept every turn they take, including the ones that break your plot.
When they end it, it's ended.

materials.id: Gak perlu apa-apa.
materials.en: Nothing at all.

imageAlt.id: Lampu tidur, dua bantal, dan buku terbuka berhalaman kosong.
imageAlt.en: A bedside lamp, two pillows and an open book with blank pages.

id: one-real-step

title.en: One real step in the cooking

why.id: Bukan masak-masakan. Satu langkah asli dr makanan yg beneran dimakan keluarga, dikerjakan sm dia.
why.en: Not pretend cooking. One genuine step of the meal the family actually eats, done by them.

id: Pilih satu langkah yg aman: menyobek selada, mengupas pisang, mengoles mentega, mengaduk di luar api.
Kasih alat yg beneran, ukuran anak kalau ada.
Waktu makan, sebutkan bagian mana yg dia yg buat.
en: Choose one safe step: tearing lettuce, peeling a banana, spreading butter, stirring off the heat.
Give them the real tool, child-sized if you have one.
At the table, say out loud which part they made.

materials.id: Apa pun yg memang sedang kamu masak.
materials.en: Whatever you're already cooking.

safety.id: Jauh dr kompor, gak ada yg tajam, gak ada yg panas. Cuci tangan dulu, dan orang dewasa tetap di dapur.
safety.en: Nothing at the stove, nothing sharp, nothing hot. Hands washed, and an adult stays in the kitchen.

imageAlt.id: Sendok kayu ukuran anak dan mangkuk di meja dapur rendah dgn selada tersobek.
imageAlt.en: A child-sized wooden spoon and a bowl on a low counter with torn lettuce beside.
